about_the_game:
Skin Tailor is a medieval horror dress-up and visual novel hybrid. Skin your supernatural enemies, create disguises and infiltrate vampire owned blood farms to rescue your comrades.

Gameplay

As a horror dress up and visual novel hybrid, Skin Tailor will let you combine various items to create your own outfits and disguises. Some of the items you will create yourself, such as the skin disguises, to hide your human smell from vampires. Each of those items will affect your stats, which become vital to survive stat checks during infiltrations or even just dialogue. It will also include narrative choices, such as the locations you want to visit, who of the characters you will trust, help or even betray. And if you're lucky, you might even be able to seduce someone. 

Story

Vampires invaded your homeland and establish themselves as the new rulers. To fill their blood farms they turned your fellow soldiers into war prisoners. You swore to rescue them, even if it means creating disguises made of vampire skin, to hide your human smell during your planned infiltration mission. Your experience as battle surgeon will be perfect for that task.

Find the blood farms, study their layout and convince guards and other related figures to give you access. Only then can you hope to see your comrades again. 

Features 

  • Bloody skin surgeries to craft your skin disguises

  • Dress Up Game Mechanic. The right combo will give you the needed stats to survive stat checks. 

  • Gather and create equipment for your rescue missions. Make sure you create convincing identities, like a blood farm worker, or even a vampire noble. 

  • Narrative heavy focus. 

  • Gritty and dark art style

  • Medieval and gothic music to emphasize the oppressive world of "Skin Tailor"

  • A vampire companion who provides blood magic to make the tailored skins even more believable and lifelike. But how much can you really trust this human-friendly vampire? Or maybe there's even something more intimate that they desire from you? 

  • Various interesting characters to meet, such as a devout vampire priest, hedonistic vampire nobles, a tall vampire lady who trades rare blood, the human flagellant leader, whose feverish faith is a double-edged sword, and many more. 

Historical background

The city in which most of the story will be set in is Esztergom, Hungary, in 1241. That was the year it was besieged by the Mongols. In our story, we mix that historical event with dark fantasy, the vampires. We do our best to make a believable world, so lots of historical research has been done as well while writing our gritty story.

content_descriptors.notes:
The game is about skinning supernatural beings to make your own disguises. It will be very bloody, with a huge emphasis on body horror. 
There will be depression and alcohol abuse.
